answer: Require each new identity to climb a cost ridge: a 2-week timelocked bond of 1000 tokens that only unlocks after two consecutive attesting epochs. Every extra fake identity pays the same deposit again plus a rising marginal fee, so a hundred fakes cost a hundred bonds and the attacker's outlay grows linearly while influence does not. On-chain verification checks the bond exists and the account keeps a warm reputation ledge of completed epochs before it can earn; short-lived comet-like identities with no history are filtered out at attestation.
